title: Production technique reference
summary: Agent Skill routing into a researched electronic production technique corpus. Use when a sound design or mix task needs reasoning about why a technique works and what it trades off (synthesis choice, layering, saturation, sidechain alternatives, stereo and mono, reverb and delay, resampling), rather than REAPER mechanics.

source.note: Project Skill inside the audio workbench repository, which is not yet published.

entrypoints.title: Technique corpus the Skill routes into
